summary.shortDescription: Provisional research record for Great Power 50Q.
summary.description: Battery Mooch tested cells identified as Great Power 50Q and reported a 5000mAh nominal datasheet rating. The exact test supports a conservative 40A continuous value; higher 100A/125A figures are temperature-limited or otherwise unsuitable as the default runtime value.
highlights: Exact marketed identity is documented in an exact-model vaping test and its referenced datasheet.
Discovery value is 5000mAh and 40A continuous; higher figures are temperature-limited or pulse-oriented.
The tested cells lacked CCC and CE marks, so production and wrapper continuity remain unresolved.
Runtime admission is recorded as battery-89.
Runtime admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.

sources.limitations: Exact-model test; samples lacked CCC and CE marks and the report notes unusually inconsistent measured capacity.

claims.statement: The exact tested identity is Great Power 50Q, as named in the test report and referenced datasheet.
The referenced datasheet lists 4950mAh minimum and 5000mAh nominal capacity for the tested Great Power 50Q.
Battery Mooch estimated 40A true continuous current from the exact test; 100A was temperature-limited and the datasheet's 125A/180A figures are not conservative runtime values.
The exact Great Power 50Q has an eligible exact-model vaping battery test.
The current Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact Great Power 50Q preset.
